summary: Load-time dropper fetches and executes remote binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: index.js unconditionally requires./_platform on load, and _platform.js runs a top-level setup() that downloads a platform-specific binary from one of three string-concat-obfuscated Cloudflare workers.dev hosts (oob-worker.cf101-adf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf103-070.workers.dev), with a DNS-TXT base64 covert-channel fallback resolving through tin.dl.well1.site, tina.dl.well1.site, ldr.dl.well1.site, and win.dl.well1.site. The fetched bytes are written to /tmp or %TEMP% under disguised names (.cache_<uid>, dotnet_diag_<uid>.exe), chmod'd 0o755, and spawned detached via /bin/sh -c or cmd /c start. Hostnames, DNS fallback domains, and the child_process require are reconstructed at runtime via array-join splits to evade static analysis. A parallel, more elaborate dropper implementation ships in lib/telemetry.js (HTTPS + DNS-TXT fallback, base64-assembled payload, chmod 0o755, spawn /bin/sh -c). Requiring or installing the package causes unattended fetch-and-execute of an opaque native binary from anonymous infrastructure on the installer's host.
